messages.text:
BL-1730 — A property-lane fork worker that dies on the V8 heap cap is reported only as 'Channel closed' / ERR_IPC_CHANNEL_CLOSED with no file named - BL-1651's per-file ceiling is checked after each test, so an allocation that outruns it between checks kills the worker first (its invariant 1, 'fails as that file, by name', does not hold for that shape), and on 2026-09-25 naming the two offenders took two hand bisections over 77 files: the death names the file that worker was running, in the lane output and in the property guard's refusal log
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: Sign-off on the new feature file: two scenarios, both over fixture property files under a small cap, never the full lane. FIRM: the cap, the per-file ceiling and the fork pool are unchanged. This ticket only adds a name to a death that already happens. FIRM: the name is the file the dead worker was…
BL-1730 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1730" (or "reject BL-1730 <reason>") to act.
